reports.title: Proctor Base Comparison
reports.summary: Three candidate bases for a customisable proctor beside the students; the spike recommended a new head on today's body, the owner chose the Quaternius kit.

reports.title: Faster, Reliable Tests
reports.summary: How the Unity test suite went from about 11 to about 5 minutes with no flaky failures: retried saves on Windows file locks, 10x PlayMode, one UI clock.

reports.title: Localization
reports.summary: Seven languages with every player-facing string translated, names drawn in the career's language, layout checked in each language and a Japanese font.

reports.title: Calm Students
reports.summary: Why exam students were always moving, and the calmer room now: mostly writing, shorter gestures, the same cheating and sounds, checked on a phone.

reports.title: Career Balance
reports.summary: How fast careers climb, how easily they change schools, what they earn and when the store is bought, before and after the shipped Target tuning.

reports.title: UI QA Playthrough
reports.summary: A new player's Galaxy A15 run found 33 UI problems (30 fixed, 3 partly), plus three follow-ups.

reports.title: UI Overhaul
reports.summary: Complete: every screen redesigned in six phases, from gold-coin paydays and a tile hub to one-sentence cards, a light-touch exam HUD, Light that reads and fast screens on a phone.

reports.title: Light Theme
reports.summary: The Dark, Light and Follow phone theme choice, every screen in Dark beside Light, its contrast, and the fixed switch checked on the Galaxy A15.

reports.title: Sound Hints and Phone Detector
reports.summary: Whether row-numbered sound hints and the Phone Detector make cheaters too easy to catch: students per hint, old against new, bot careers, a fairness fix and options.

reports.title: Texture Compression
reports.summary: Clean APK sizes for stronger ASTC settings on the baked art, the decoded pixels beside today's 6x6, and a recommended 3.55 MB saving.

reports.title: Phone Performance
reports.summary: Why exams juddered at 63-70 fps and froze for half a second on a Galaxy A15, and the steady 45 fps and shorter freezes after the fixes.

reports.title: Wardrobe
reports.summary: The supervisor's body, the store's Wardrobe with a live preview, 36 clothing items, how their prices fit a career's earnings, and a keep-some-coins hint.

reports.title: School Rooms
reports.summary: The eight schools' exam rooms on a phone and two tablets, with desk counts by rating and how room size sets pace and difficulty.

reports.title: Student Characters
reports.summary: The exam students' bodies, hair, clothes and left-handers, every animation clip, the whispering pair in a real exam, and the known limits.

reports.title: Classroom Door and Walking Paths
reports.summary: Every walk a student takes in the eight rooms, bathroom trips included: why they walked into the wall and each other, and the opening door and clear routes now.

reports.title: Admission Photo Check
reports.summary: The photo check at the door: the document photo beside a live camera still, every case on a phone screen, and the waiting queue.

reports.title: Whisper Sound
reports.summary: The whisper in the game: real recordings made wordless, in male and female voices matched to the student, with audio and measurements.

reports.title: Exam Bell Sounds
reports.summary: Fifteen bells synthesized in code for the end of exam time, each playable with its parameters, including the electric bell now in the game.

reports.title: App Icon and Shop Art
reports.summary: The launcher icon, a calm exam room, against sixteen simpler alternatives for Pencils Down! at 48 px, under masks and on home screens, plus the Blender shop tiles.

reports.title: Baked Game Art
reports.summary: The game's Blender-rendered art: a building per school, the exam room on the title and brief, event objects and icons, in both themes.

reports.title: Game Feel
reports.summary: The reward motion: coins flying to the balance on payday, a result card that counts up, a lit promotion and a toast for each action.

reports.title: Schools and Offers
reports.summary: Eight schools with fixed star ratings in half-star steps, how job offers compare rating and salary, and how school rating follows standing across whole careers.

reports.title: Phone Check
reports.summary: The game on a real Galaxy A15: the new app icon, shop tiles and Wardrobe on the latest build, plus every school room, offers and event art.

reports.title: Proctor Creator
reports.summary: The new proctor in the game: a free create-your-proctor step at each new career and the Wardrobe's You segment, with faces, hair, builds and colours on every outfit.

reports.title: Proctor Character
reports.summary: The proctor on the Quaternius base: man and woman with face, brow, hair and colour presets, whole-body builds, three clips, and all 42 wardrobe items on both bodies.
